A [[shooting guard]], in 2022, Gradey was named the boy's [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade national player of the year]]. ==High school career== Gradey started high school at [[Wichita Collegiate School]] in [[Wichita, Kansas]], where he spent two years. In his final year with the school, he averaged 20 points a game while reaching the state playoffs.{{Cite web |date=2020-07-01 |title=Kansas basketball star Gradey Dick has two years of high school left, but is already a high-level DI recruit |url=https://bvmsports.com/2020/07/01/kansas-basketball-star-gradey-dick-has-two-years-of-high-school-left-but-is-already-a-high-level-di-recruit/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=BVM Sports |language=en-US}} He subsequently transferred to Sunrise Christian Academy. He played two years for the school, averaging 18 points a game in his senior year.{{Cite web |title=Kansas commit Gradey Dick wins Gatorade National Boys Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/kansas-commit-gradey-dick-wins-gatorade-national-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year-203120510.html |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=sports.yahoo.com |language=en-US}} He was named to the rosters for the [[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]], and [[Nike Hoop Summit]].{{Cite web |title=Sunrise star Gradey Dick named McDonald's All-American |url=https://www.kake.com/story/45726646/sunrise-star-gradey-dick-named-mcdonalds-allamerican |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=www.kake.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=USA team set for Nike Hoop Summit |url=https://247sports.com/LongFormArticle/Nike-Hoop-Summit-USA-Basketball-Dereck-Lively-Kyle-Filipowski-Keyonte-George-Dariq-Whitehead-Nick-Smith-183665404/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=247Sports |language=en-US}} On March 22, 2022, Gradey was named the [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade National Player of the Year]].{{Cite web |title=Gradey Dick wins Gatorade National Player of the Year award |url=https://www.kwch.com/2022/03/22/gradey-dick-wins-gatorade-national-player-year-award/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=kwch.com |date=2022-06-08 |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2022-03-23 |title=Gradey Dick Earns Gatorade National Boys Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://www.slamonline.com/college-hs/gradey-dick-gatorade-player-of-the-year-kansas/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=SLAM |language=en}} ===Recruiting=== He received basketball scholarship offers from [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]], [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]], and [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]], among others, during his first two years of high school.{{Cite web |title=Class of 2022 Kansas target Gradey Dick transferring to Sunrise Academy {{!}} Tale of the Tait |url=http://www2.kusports.com/weblogs/tale-tait/2020/apr/28/class-of-2022-kansas-target-gradey-dick-/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=KUsports.com |language=en}} He emerged as a five-star recruit during his tenure with Sunrise Christian Academy. On March 3, 2021, he committed to play college basketball for Kansas over offers from [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida]] and [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]].{{Cite web a freshman, he averaged 14.1 points, 5.1 rebounds and 1.7 assists per game. On March 31, 2023, Gradey declared for the [[2023 NBA draft|2023 NBA draft]]. {{Cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonothan |date=March 31, 2023 |title= Kansas freshman Gradey Dick to enter NBA draft|url= https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/36019182/kansas-freshman-gradey-dick-enter-nba-draft |url-status=live}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2022–23 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] | 36|| 36 || 32.7 || .442 || .403 || .854 || 5.1 || 1.7 || 1.4 || .3 || 14.1 |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career || 36 || 36 || 32.7 || .442 || .403 || .854 || 5.1 || 1.7 || 1.4 || .3 || 14.1 {{S-end}} ==National team career== Dick represented the [[FIBA 3x3 Under-18 World Cup|United States]] at the [[FIBA 3x3 Under-18 World Cup|2021 FIBA 3x3 Under-18 World Cup]] in [[Debrecen]]. He averaged 3.2 points, helping his team win the gold medal.{{Cite web |title=KU commitment Gradey Dick brings home gold medal with Team USA at 3-on-3 World Cup {{!}} Tale of the Tait |url=http://www2.kusports.com/weblogs/tale-tait/2021/aug/30/ku-commitment-gradey-dick-brings-home-go/ |access-date=2022-06-08 |website=KUsports.com |language=en}} ==Personal life== He is a [[Christianity|Christian]].
